The stamp is written before --out is opened, so an uncomputable stamp refuses the RUN, not just the file. With --out omitted (print-only) the document is still stamped in memory; nothing is written either way.

Rows sha is taken from the rows FILE PATH argument after it is read; a rows file mutated between read and stamp would be stamped at its post-read bytes, which is the honest bytes on disk at write time.
